reviews.reason: AgentFlowCanvas keeps ZoomToolbar, ViewportObserver, PendingLocateNodeEffect, the inner canvas and the ReactFlowProvider wrapper at module scope. These component types remain stable across renders; element projection and ReactFlow synchronization belong to useAgentFlowCanvasElements. P116 reassessed 2026-11-17: the complete P115 Workflow witness diff only moves canonical transient cleanup into the validated synchronous run-start callback and revises its adjacent detail comment. Canvas source, helper bodies and its Workflow JSX are byte-identical. P114 restricts setSelection to six selection fields; neither change creates render-local component definitions or changes provider/helper ownership.

ViewportObserver observes the external ReactFlow provider viewport and sends x/y/zoom snapshots to the existing parent refs used by save/restore. Its effect depends on the viewport primitives and callback, and the Workflow callback only assigns viewportSnapshotRef.current. P116 reassessed 2026-11-17: P115 moves canonical transient cleanup to validated run start; the full old/new Frame diff leaves both viewport callbacks and the save/restore ref consumers unchanged. Canvas source and observer effects are byte-identical. P114 narrows setSelection without changing viewport ownership. The callback synchronizes an external viewport snapshot and does not establish parent React state derived from child state.

ViewportObserver registers the mounted ReactFlow provider getter with onViewportGetterReady and releases it with null in cleanup. Its separate viewport effect reports external x/y/zoom snapshots; existing consumers store the getter and snapshots in refs used by save/restore. P116 reassessed 2026-11-17: P115 only moves canonical transient cleanup to validated run start; the full old/new Workflow diff preserves both viewport callback bodies. Canvas source and observer dependencies remain unchanged. P114 changes selection projection only. These effects maintain an external-provider registration/snapshot lifecycle rather than mirroring local child React state into parent React state.

This existing handler is a live controller callback, not a component type. It updates selectedVariable only when key matches and invokes debugSession.setVariableCacheValue; no child effect or memo compares this callback to own a native lifetime. AgentFlowCanvasFrame retains editor UI composition and draft/session orchestration; useCanvasDockLayout owns all dock state/ResizeObserver/resize cleanup, and useCanvasNodePreview owns missing-variable planning and run receipts. The export mutation only reads a generated archive and saves it locally; it does not change backend catalog data. P21b reassessed 2026-11-17: Canvas changes add run locking, stable action refs and functional node/edge synchronization while retaining module-level ViewportObserver registration/cleanup and x/y/zoom notification. Frame and Workflow witnesses now consume backend analysis and fence running interactions; canvas interaction tests retain readable selection and assert graph writes stay blocked during a run. Separate dock and preview hooks retain resource ownership. P21c stabilizes omitted assembly defaults after proving downstream identity consumers; that default-value tuple stays held. The public flow-editor facade remains the kernel boundary. Environment/conversation panels still own editable commit/cancel drafts, and current resize handles include keyboard callbacks and orientation/value semantics.
